title: Internationalisation readiness: extracted strings, locale-aware formatting, RTL-safe layout
description: All user-facing strings live in an extraction layer, none hard-coded in components. Dates, numbers, and currency render through locale-aware formatting. The layout survives an RTL locale without visual breakage: mirrored ordering where required, no clipped or overlapped text. Shipping additional translations is out of scope; readiness is in scope.
rationale: Retrofitting extraction into a string-littered codebase costs an order of magnitude more than building against it. Readiness now is what keeps localisation a content task later.
